description: This file defines two custom exception classes, RandomlyInjectedStorageException and RandomlyInjectedInconsistentStateException, used for testing purposes within the Orleans.TestingHost namespace. The classes are serializable and include constructors for default instantiation and deserialization.

classes.name: RandomlyInjectedStorageException
classes.description: A serializable exception class representing a randomly injected storage fault, derived from System.Exception.

classes.name: RandomlyInjectedInconsistentStateException
classes.description: A serializable exception class representing a randomly injected inconsistent state fault, derived from InconsistentStateException.

methods.name: RandomlyInjectedStorageException
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the exception with a fixed message 'injected fault'.

methods.name: RandomlyInjectedStorageException
methods.description: Obsolete constructor used for deserialization, accepting SerializationInfo and StreamingContext.

methods.description: Default constructor initializing the exception with a fixed message 'injected fault'.
